# Veyro Labs

> Custom-coded web design and development (Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js) by Arcan Bereket in Hamburg, Germany. No templates, no website builders, no agency hand-offs, full code ownership.

## Overview
- **Founder & Developer:** Arcan Bereket (Hamburg, Germany)
- **Languages:** German (`de`), English (`en`)
- **Contact:** veyro-labs@gmx.de | +49 176 5590599
- **Tech Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Three.js, WebGL Shaders, GSAP
- **Business Model:** Fixed upfront pricing in quote, 100% code ownership on handover, no recurring subscription or platform lock-in. Small business under § 19 UStG (no VAT charged).

## Packages & Guide Prices
- **Landing Page (from €1,200):** High-converting custom-coded landing page, 95+ Lighthouse score, <1s load time, technical SEO foundation, contact form included. Typical turnaround: 5–7 business days.
- **Website (€2,500 – €4,500):** Up to 5 custom pages, memorable 3D & animations, optional CMS integration, technical SEO, walkthrough on handover. Typical turnaround: 2–4 weeks.
- **Premium Custom (from €6,000):** Full brand identity (logo, colors, typography, voice), custom 3D scenes & shaders, strategy, direct post-launch support.
